run.name: Sunoco LP
run.title: CP-OS host session (SUN)
run.summary: Sunoco LP's credit profile has improved to 3.51x net leverage and USD 3,060 million of liquidity, supported by diversified earnings, but it rests on recently acquired earnings, management-adjusted EBITDA and sponsor control. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (consolidated, management-adjusted), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 13,163 US$m and cash 760 US$m at 2026-09-30 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 3,535 US$m (derived). One month of Parkland (October 2025) still absent; reported covenant net leverage 3.5x. Offen debt funding after quarter end not included.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 3,535 US$m over LTM interest paid 726 US$m (derived). On net interest expense of 768 US$m the cover is 4.60x. The covenant Interest Coverage Ratio uses a credit-agreement definition not seen.

cash.basis: Cash. Unused availability after 111 US$m borrowings (substantially all CAD-denominated) and 84 US$m of letters of credit (Q3 10-Q page:15). Facility matures 2030-06-17, so nothing expires within twelve months. Cash is consolidated and not tested for trapped or restricted amounts.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Trailing earnings are not pro forma, debt documents are not supplied, and the funding of the Offen acquisition is not stated.
CP-1 main limitation: Trailing earnings still omit pre-acquisition Parkland months, covenant terms are not seen in executed form, and ratios rest on management-adjusted EBITDA.
